description: Official surcharge rules, VAT policy, and special conditions for all tourist vehicle rates in Nepal.
base_rate_note: All rates listed in natta_routes.jsonl are the CAR base rate in Nepali Rupees (NPR). To get the price for any other vehicle, multiply the car base rate by that vehicle's multiplier from natta_multipliers.json.

vat.note: 13% VAT is NOT included in any listed rates. Always add 13% VAT on top of the final calculated price.

after_8pm.description: Arrival, Departure, and Disposal trips that start or finish after 8:00 PM are charged at 1.5x the base rate.

after_midnight.description: Trips that start or finish after 12:00 AM midnight are charged at 2.0x the base rate.

offroad_gravel_hill.description: Off-road, gravel road, and hill road trips incur an additional 25% charge on top of the standard rate.

disposal_rules.note: Disposal (hourly hire) has a minimum charge of 4 hours (Half Day). You cannot book disposal for less than 4 hours.
disposal_rules.full_day_note: Full Day Disposal is 8 hours. After 8 PM the per-hour rate applies for additional hours.

overnight_stay.description: Per night overnight stay charge for the driver. Multiply by vehicle multiplier for other vehicle types.
overnight_stay.note: Applies for every overnight stop during a multi-day itinerary.

facilities.note: Air conditioning and all other available facilities in the vehicle are included in the listed rates.

within_ring_road_pickup.description: Tour officer or guide pick-up and drop within Kathmandu Ring Road.
within_ring_road_pickup.note: Multiply by vehicle multiplier for other vehicle types.

calculation_guide: Step 1: Find the route in natta_routes.jsonl and get the car_base_rate_npr. Step 2: Multiply by the vehicle multiplier from natta_multipliers.json based on number of passengers. Step 3: Apply road type surcharge (+25%) if applicable. Step 4: Apply time surcharge (x1.5 after 8PM, x2.0 after midnight) if applicable. Step 5: Add 13% VAT for the final price.
